name: Peor
line: Peor is a mountain peak in Moab where Balak took Balaam to curse Israel, and its name later came to mean Israel's sin and the plague.

moments.title: Balak takes Balaam up Peor
moments.text: Balak led Balaam to the top of Peor, hoping God would let him curse Israel from there. Balaam had seven altars built, and Balak offered a bull and a ram on each one.

moments.title: The plague because of Peor
moments.text: Israel was led into unfaithfulness to the LORD at Peor through the counsel of Balaam. A plague struck the congregation, and the LORD later told Israel to attack the Midianites for what they did there.

moments.title: Remembering the sin of Peor
moments.text: When the tribes west of the Jordan feared that an altar was rebellion, they asked if the sin of Peor was not enough. They reminded everyone that it had brought a plague on the LORD's people.
